name: Data.boxes_endWeightData_le
summary: Bound the boxes and exponents of a Harish-Chandra parameter by the size of its entries, which `Data.abs_gridParam_le` bounds by ⌈20b⌉.

steps.claim: For the parameter −gridParam(z, 0, j, m) (entries at most ⌈20b⌉ in absolute value, `Data.abs_gridParam_le`), `boxes_le_of_isHCParam` gives boxes(κ, |L|) ≤ |N|·|L|·⌈20b⌉ and |e(τ)| ≤ ⌈20b⌉.
steps.lean:
have := boxes_le_of_isHCParam ((D.endWeightData z).2.2.2 j h) (by simpa using
    (D.abs_gridParam_le · h le_rfl))

steps.claim: With |EndIndex(z, j)| ≤ 2n_m (`Data.card_gridIndex_le`), the product is at most b₁·r⁴ by the size comparisons of the data (`Data.nat_le_of_hasLogBound`).
steps.lean: grw [this.1, card_gridIndex_le] <;> simp [h, this]; exact D.nat_le_of_hasLogBound
